findings.text: run_log, the header block, ARMS, subset_arguments and the warm/control loops duplicate scripts/prototypes/cached_point_remeasure/run_job.sh rather than adding a pinned-root mode to that existing driver, so the two prototype drivers will drift; the repository already owns this orchestration.

The census paragraph attributes four jit__source_jets rows to the census read's guard rows, but the read's own CACHE_GUARD_RECEIPT carries only the 250-cell and 500-cell programs as hits=1 (jit__source_jets-a557e410 and -05e44f0d); the other two named rows (-3cfcee9b, -cbc06ad3) come from the replayed CACHE_GUARD_PREWARM record, not from the read, so 'every point program of that read' overstates provenance even though the read's requested programs did hit.

The comment refers to 'the earlier node', a plan-node reference the naming rules forbid in source comments; state the mechanism (a 64-node grid subset exercises the same first call) without the plan reference.

The usage header documents only STEP and RECEIPT_DIRECTORY, but the census and control steps exit on the undocumented NOVA_PINNED_CACHE_COPY (line 167), NOVA_PINNED_OPERAND_STORE (line 175) and NOVA_PINNED_CONTROL_CACHE (line 110) without which those steps cannot run, so the committed driver is not reproducible from its own header.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit from fe05f648d to fe5f2294c; five commits, two files, both inside scope, with conventional subjects and bodies and no AI attribution.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when's load clause is asserted by the lane gate over tests/test_cached_point_remeasure.py (misses==0, first_call_seconds<=60, peak<=64GB); the manifest records that run (1 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0) and the warm receipts corroborate it.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to measure the four point-program arms served from the pinned cache and record the result; scripts/prototypes/pinned_point_program/run_job.sh and docs/evidence/fragments/kernel-compile-barrier/pinned-point-program.html deliver both, with the four-row table, control, job ids and log paths.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, the five commits, the lane gate command and the control log, and its claimed numbers match the receipts on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The diff touches only scripts/prototypes/pinned_point_program/run_job.sh and docs/evidence/fragments/kernel-compile-barrier/pinned-point-program.html, both inside the declared paths.
